failure_reasons.object_identity_not_preserved: One or both Controlled objects are not recognizable as the source objects.
failure_reasons.original_color_binding_mismatch: Controlled Original does not preserve the Natural Original color binding.
failure_reasons.edited_color_binding_mismatch: Controlled Edited does not preserve the Natural Edited color binding.
failure_reasons.edited_cutout_reuse_violation: Controlled Edited did not use the authoritative edited cutout asset.
failure_reasons.placement_mismatch_between_conditions: Controlled Original and Edited use different positions, sizes, or canvas geometry.
failure_reasons.relative_scale_not_preserved: A/B relative object scale was not preserved under one shared scale factor.
failure_reasons.canvas_clipping: An object is clipped by the Controlled canvas.
failure_reasons.alpha_boundary_artifact: A material alpha edge, halo, or boundary artifact is visible.
failure_reasons.invalid_background: The background is inconsistent, non-neutral, or differs between conditions.
failure_reasons.prompt_or_answer_invalid: One or more of the four images no longer supports an unambiguous question and answer.
failure_reasons.missing_or_corrupted_asset: A required input or output asset is absent, unreadable, or checksum-invalid.
failure_reasons.other: A failure not covered above; a review note is mandatory.
